Quinn checks six brake assemblies per day.
Wes checks two haul cables per day.
Quinn labels three tool drawers per day.

Individual winter extremes are not listed.

If an incident review is open, retain the affected slips until that review closes.
Acknowledge ticket requests within one service day.
This acknowledgement does not guarantee a reserved seat.

Its restoration took place in 1988.
